values.ONE_LEG: Standing on one leg (kicks, teeps, knees). Exploited by catch-kick takedowns, sweeps, counter crosses.
values.HANDS_LOW: Guard is down (lazy jab return, shot attempt, fatigue). Exploited by overhands, head kicks, knees.
values.HEAD_LOW: Head below the opponent's chest (level change, shot). Exploited by knees, guillotines, front headlocks, uppercuts.
values.COMING_IN: Stepping in to tie up or shoot, hands busy (clinch entry, the start of a shot). Exploited by jabs, crosses, teeps and knees, which stop the entry (#18).
values.LEANING: Weight overcommitted forward (wild hook/overhand). Exploited by counter hooks, trips, level changes.
values.BACK_TO_CAGE: Pinned against the fence. Exploited by cage takedowns and clinch knees.
values.POSTURE_BROKEN: Posture pulled down in the clinch or guard. Exploited by bottom submissions and sweeps.
